text:
maria: Quick heads-up — int3 ONNX bring-up shows scoring drift vs float16 on the 2k golden subset. Need a focused rescore + labeling sanity check :eyes:

aj: can you paste the diff sample path and a short repro? :mag:

maria: s3://redwood-curation/experiments/int3_rescore/golden-diff-2k.csv
Also repro command:
```
rc eval rescore --model onnx-int3 --input s3://redwood-curation/experiments/int3_rescore/golden-diff-2k.csv \n  --output /tmp/int3_rescore.csv --limit 2000 --batch-size 8
```

nora: I can spin up a 4h labeling burst, pinging label squad. How many labelers do you want? :calendar:

maria: start with 10 labelers, priority P1. Focus on examples where BLEU/EM dropped > 5 points and where rerank order flipped.

samir: quick note — tokenizer-v3 changes the tokenization boundaries; we saw fingerprint shifts last week. Can we add a token-delta filter? Suggest `token_delta > 3` to exclude spurious hits.

aj: good call. Add tokenizer fingerprint column to the rescore output, e.g., `--emit-token-hash` so labelers can triage.

labeler-bot: ticket created: CRT-1287 — "int3 rescore + golden relabel" assigned to curation-burst, est 4 hours. :ticket:

ops-bot: ONNX bench nodes updated to int3-runner@v1.3. Deploy tag: deploy-2026-03-21-int3. Throughput stable, latency +15ms median.

nora: labelers are live. I'll post status every 30m and surface top 50 disagreements.

maria: thanks — once we have relabel results, run the eval diff with `rc eval compare --baseline float16 --candidate onnx-int3 --gold /tmp/relabelled_gold.csv`. If regression persists we'll roll back the quant kernel. Tagging #eng-releases if we need a canary pause. :warning:

aj: noted. I'll prepare the compare job and queue it. Keep logs in /var/logs/curation/int3-rescore/

maria: closing loop — P1 until we confirm no recall regression. Thanks everyone.
